description: Application for a Non-Material Change (Paragraph 21, Schedule 17 of the High Speed Rail (London-West Midlands) Act 2017) in relation to approval reference 252636HS2 dated 02/09/2025 for: Development authorised by the High Speed Rail (London-West Midlands) Act 2017 relating to the design or external appearance of a drainage outfall adjacent to the River Brent (Building Works) and earthworks, where they are required as part of the proposed drainage outfall design (Earthworks) (Schedule 17 of the HS2 Act). Amendment seeks the lowering of the headwall slab level by 0.5 metres and a minor alteration to the gradient of the rip rap drainage section between the headwall and adjacent wingwall
